title: Experiment orchestration checklist for ops liaisons (working)
content:
PURPOSE
This is a lightweight operational checklist and decision playbook for the person acting as the Ops Liaison during cross-functional experiments (canaries + A/B). Aim: make fast, consistent calls when signals diverge across telemetry, UX, and cost.

SCOPE
- Applies to staged rollouts for: new model variants, routing/fallback logic, batching/quantization changes, and latency-optimizing infra patches.
- Not for full infra upgrades that require SRE change windows (those follow the SRE quarterly runbook).

WHO IS THE OPS LIAISON?
- Role: single point for coordinating real-time decisions during an activation window.
- Nomination: product lead nominates a liaison 48h before exposure; must be oncall-capable and have access to the rollout dashboard.
- Authority: can pause/revert traffic slices per gate rules below and call hotfixes.

PRE-LAUNCH (72–2h before exposure) — quick checklist
- Confirm traffic slices and weight table published in the rollout config. (owner: product)
- Verify telemetry dashboards are ready: token-latency, p50/p95/p99; error-rate by route; cost-per-request; human-review queue depth. (owner: observability)
content_2:
- Synthetic cohort seeds uploaded (see SEED-2025-09). Run 1 synthetic smoke test against canary model and baseline; check for divergence > 5% on quality metric. (owner: applied-ml)
- Ops Liaison checklist: Slack channel created, Pager duty hook verified, phone tree noted.
- Decision precommit: set initial exposure duration (default 2h), intermediate checkpoints (15m, 45m, 90m), and final gating criteria.

CANARY DESIGN (example template)
- Unit: route-level canary (10% of users in cohort A)
- Duration: 2h staged (10% -> 30% -> 100% over 3 waves)
- Metrics observed: latency p95 (+/- baseline), API error-rate, user-facing degrade ratio, cost per 1k tokens, semantic-quality regression (eval set A/B).
- Guarded thresholds: p95 latency increase > 30% = pause; error-rate increase > 2 percentage points absolute = pause; cost increase > 40% without quality gain = investigate + manual gate.

A/B ALLOCATION HEURISTICS
- Keep sample independence where possible. Use hash-based routing keyed on user-id to prevent reallocation churn.
- If feature is user-level sticky: randomize at the user-id level; if session-level: request-id hashing.
- Minimum sample size: avoid allocations < 1k active users for any 1h window unless synthetic-only.

SAFETY GATES (ops-liaison quick-decision guide)
- Green: all metrics inside thresholds across 2 consecutive checkpoints -> proceed to next wave.
- Yellow: one metric breaches slightly (within 1.5x threshold) or noisy signal -> hold, escalate to product + applied-ml for 10–20min triage.
- Red: any threshold breach (as defined above) OR sustained negative UX (user complaints > 2x baseline in 30m) -> immediate pause + revert rule triggered.

SYNTHETIC/TOOLING CHECKS (fast signal enrichment)
- Run rapid inference on fixed probe set (200 prompts) to compute BLEU-style and policy-safety deltas. If model produces high-confidence hallucinations on probes -> red.
- Run deterministic rerank tests if routing changes: verify top-3 stability.
- Check KV/cache warmup: measure first-200-requests latency curve; abnormal tail -> consider pre-warm.

OBSERVABILITY RUNBOOK (what the Ops Liaison watches)
- Live dashboard tabs (must be open): 1) Traffic & allocations 2) Latency (p50/p95/p99) by route 3) Error rates by code+model 4) Cost per 1k tokens & token distribution 5) Semantic quality regression vs eval set 6) Human-review queue (if applicable)
- Fast triage commands (ChatOps snippets):
  - /pause-rollout {slice} (automated revert & email)
  - /revert-config {config-id} (fallback to previous model)
  - /increase-observation {slice} (hold for manual decision)

COMMUNICATION TEMPLATES (ops liaison uses these)
- Pause message (Slack): "PAUSE: Canary wave {n} for {feature}. Observed {metric} breaching threshold ({value}). Reverting to baseline. Team: applied-ml + infra on triage."
- Proceed message: "PROCEED: Wave {n} moved to {weight} after 2 clean checkpoints. Monitoring for next 90m."

POST-LAUNCH (within 24h)
- Data capture: mark time windows for sampling, export request traces for failed requests, tag logs with experiment-id.
- Short retro: 1h post-mortem call if any gate fired; otherwise a 30m signal-check in.
- Experiment artefacts to save: probe results, chat log, dashboards snapshot, and final decisions. Link to experiment card in Confluence.

ESCALATION PATHS
- Tier 1: Ops Liaison + product + applied-ml. If unresolved in 20m -> SRE + incident lead.
- For security or PII exposure suspicion -> immediately page security team and stop traffic.

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF
- How strict should cost gates be for high-value customers? (Priya to propose SLAs/waivers)
- Should we allow automatic soft-fallback (lower-cost variant) versus hard revert? (Evan to prototype automated fallback decision tree).
- Add a short-run automated sanity-checker that computes semantic shift percentile; integrate into rollout precommit.

ACTION ITEMS (owners)
- Linh: add ops-liaison to rollout template in console (due 2025-09-10).
- Priya: propose cost-waiver policy and a waiver flag for select customers (due 2025-09-17).
- Evan: implement ChatOps snippets and verify perms (PR#4821 linked).
- Marta: create the synthetic probe seeds and upload to S3(SEED-2025-09).

QUICK LINKS
- Rollout contracts confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ROLL/rollout-contracts
- Example Jira: ENG-2345 (cost gating spike investigation)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

NOTES ON STYLE / PRACTICALITY
- This doc is intentionally short. Ops Liaisons should print or pin the top-of-dash cheat-sheet and keep this doc open during activations.
- This is a living doc — capture any deviation from the checklist in the experiment card and update the thresholds if needed.
